correctness.rationale: For strictly positive states of the explicitly specified mirror-ghost map, algebraic cancellation of the fixed point equation gives the reflecting harmonic system for w=\(u|G_hu|^{p-2}\). A self-contained finite maximum principle forces w constant, a mirrored corner has zero centered gradient so \(w=0\), and \(u>0\) then forces zero gradient everywhere. Two coordinate recurrences give exactly four independent parity-class values, with converse direct. This is valid for every \(p>2\) and every positive step. Every axial edge of the two-color checkerboard jumps by |a-b| and there are exactly 2N(N+1) edges, proving energy 2(1+1/N)N^p|a-b|^p. For \(p>3\), derivative of |z|^(p-2) at zero vanishes, giving \(DT=I\). The exact-rational checker passed 982 finite tests (not used as a universal proof). The theorem distinguishes the mathematically stipulated side ghost completion from unspecified alternatives.

value.rationale: The question is motivated by physical equilibrium fidelity of a new positivity-preserving diffusion method rather than a free-standing parity example. The theorem exhaustively identifies all positive stationary states for any grid or step, exhibits arbitrarily high-contrast frozen nonconstant checkerboards with quantified \(O(h^{-p})\) edge energy, and shows an identity Jacobian for \(p>3\). These exact structural obstructions distinguish positivity/constant-equilibrium preservation from diffusion of rough data and can motivate alternative gradient reconstructions and benchmark tests. The result neither asserts general instability nor contradicts convergence for smooth initial data.
